advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Document (or make live) that /health `opcert` is a boot snapshot while `store` is recomputed per request, so a post-boot pinning-config change is not silently reflected as stale.
evidence: The binding is fixed at boot so a stale signer is arguably fine, but the pinned-key config (trusted_environments.yaml) can change on disk and would not be re-read.
advisory.finding: The /health `opcert` field is a boot-time snapshot computed once in run_mcp (setattr(server, _OPCERT_STATUS_ATTR, opcert_signing_status(opcert_binding))), whereas the sibling `store` field is recomputed live per request (store_status()). If trusted_environments.yaml is added/edited or the binding changes after boot, the opcert field stays stale until restart, unlike store.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm a bound OpcertBinding always carries a key_path when principal is set, or distinguish 'no key_path resolvable' from 'key present but not pinned' in the opcert status.
evidence: src/rebar/_mcp_health.py:318: signer_body = _ssh_pub_body(_read_opcert_pub(key_path) if key_path else None)
src/rebar/_ssh_pub_body returns None for a falsy line (src/rebar/_opcert_signing.py:280-281)
opcert_signer_degraded returns bool(expected and not matched) — matched absent/False under a pinned deployment reads as degraded
advisory.finding: In opcert_signing_status, a bound signer whose `principal` is set but whose `key_path` is None yields signer_body=None (via _ssh_pub_body(None)) and thus matched=False when expected=True, marking the signer degraded on a missing-key-path rather than a genuine key mismatch.

blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 161 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug 879b-9bf0-86fd-4a6b has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix like this is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan 879b-9bf0-86fd-4a6b` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review 879b-9bf0-86fd-4a6b` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan 879b-9bf0-86fd-4a6b --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.
